{{Quote|Biological section does medical research for the Navy and Army.|A compilation of Galactic Empire documents by Major Arhul Hextrophon|<ref name="IS2" />}}
'''Biological''', also known as '''Biological section'''<ref name="IS2" /> and the '''Naval Biological group''',<ref name="DB">{{DB|organization|stormtroopers|stormtroopers}}</ref> was a division of the [[Support Service Branch]] of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire's]] [[Imperial Navy/Legends|Navy]]. In the [[Navy Order of Battle]], Biological represented a section of a [[support fleet]], with its symbol being a circle with two smaller [[Color/Legends|black]] circles aligned inside it on a line in the upper left&ndash;lower right direction.<ref name="IS2" />

Biological performed medical services and research for the Imperial Navy and [[Imperial Army/Legends|Army]] and was also directly responsible for the health of [[Stormtrooper/Legends|stormtroopers]]<ref name="IS2" /> of the [[Stormtrooper Corps/Legends|Stormtrooper Corps]].<ref name="IH">''[[Star Wars: Imperial Handbook: A Commander's Guide]]''</ref> Biological tried to assess the danger posed to Imperial [[Soldier/Legends|troops]] and crews by the variety of [[The galaxy/Legends|galactic]] micro-organisms, prevent the transmission of [[Disease/Legends|diseases]], and cure or remedy their symptoms. In addition, the division experimented with new wound treatment and rehabilitation methods. Shortly after the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], Biological was mentioned in a compilation of Imperial documents made by [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] [[Historian/Legends|historian]] [[Major/Legends|Major]] [[Arhul Hextrophon/Legends|Arhul Hextrophon]] for Alliance [[Supreme Commander (Alliance)/Legends|Supreme Commander]] [[Mon Mothma/Legends|Mon Mothma]] and other Rebel [[Officer/Legends|officers]].<ref name="IS2" />

==Behind the scenes==
Biological was first mentioned in [[Greg Gorden]]'s [[1989]] ''[[Imperial Sourcebook]]'' that was published by [[West End Games]] for use with ''[[Star Wars: The Roleplaying Game]]''. In the book, Biological's Order of Battle symbol was drawn by [[Sharon Wyckoff]].<ref name="ISB">''[[Imperial Sourcebook]]''</ref> The [[StarWars.com]] [[Databank (original)|Databank]] entry on stormtroopers, which was published by [[August 8]], [[2001]], introduced the alternate name "Naval Biological group" for the division.<ref name="DB" />
